Your new job as a heftruckchauffeur! You’ll work in a super team with a great salary of €15,28. You’ll get shift allowances up to 200%. You also have the chance of a permanent contract after 10 weeks! Nice, right?! Is this your new job at Kuehne + Nagel in Tilburg?!
Sign up now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions so we can help you quickly. Don't have a WhatsApp? Then we'll contact you by phone or email!

What we offer
- A great salary of €15,28
- Shift allowances up to 200%
- A fulltime job
- Travel allowances of €0,25 per kilometer
- Chance to get a fixed contract after 10 weeks!
- With the most fun colleagues 🎉

Who you are
To start as a heftruckchauffeur, it's important you meet the following requirements:

- You are available to work full time in 3 shifts;
- You speak either Dutch or English;
- You have at least half a year experience on the heftruck;
- You have your heftruck certificate;
- You like to help your colleagues in the warehouse. You're never 100% only heftruck chauffeur;
- You have your own transportation to get in Tilburg-East, like a bike or a car or a scooter;
- You don't mind working in recycling.

What will you do
Your job as a heftruckchauffeur will be really diverse. You’re in charge of different activities in the logistic process! The whole day trucks come to  load and unload their products. Those trucks are full of returns from Albert Heijn-stores. Like  empty cola bottles, beer crates or cardboard boxes! You, as a heftruckchauffeur, will move the bottles & cardboard with the klemtruck. Also, you drive the transport pallets full of beer crates to the loading docks! The truck drivers will load their own trucks, so that’s something you don’t have to do. Good to know: our heftrucks have double forks for the fusts! Nice challenge, right?

Where will you work
Is your house full of empty bottles and beer crates again? You’ll hand them in at Albert Heijn,, right? These returns eventually arrive at Kuehne

jobs.description:
Bus driver Public Transport the Netherlands

Who are we 
The Toonen Reizen coaches have been well-known on the national and international road network for almost 100 years. The fleet now includes 35 luxury coaches in various sizes. They are multifunctional for company and crew transportation, day trips, international shuttles, school trips, vacation trips and national and international events. The fleet also includes buses for sports clubs and buses for partner Flixbus. Toonen Reizen works for a wide variety of target groups, from business to individuals, and from young people to the elderly. In recent years, the company has grown without losing its family-like work environment. We work with a team of almost 100 drivers who make sure customers arrive to their destinations pleasantly and safely. 

Job Description
Toonen Reizen has a partnership with Arriva and Transdev for public transport. A number of our drivers assist them due to staff shortages and carry out public transport lines. It involves operating fixed public transport routes, with shifts scheduled during the day, night, and weekends, using various buses, including articulated buses. The collaboration is for a minimum of six months, with the possibility of an extension.
With Toonen Reizen, you will have an employment contract for 164 hours per month. These are fixed hours and it is not a flexible contract. You will carry out all work for Arriva or Transdev and will be scheduled and managed by them. Cost of accommodation are covered and no deductions are made from your salary for this.
Should the collaboration be terminated or come to an end, then there is a possibility to work at the headquarters in the Netherlands and drive all kind of touring coach work. At that point, you will be responsible for your own accommodation, though we will certainly assist you with this. You will find more about our regular coach operations below.

Our offer
•    You will be considered for a contract for six-months with fixed hours (164 hours per month). With the prospect of extension and a permanent contract. 
•    You will be given a variety of clothing to wear during trips;
•    An independent and responsible position in a leading organization within the industry;
•    For salary, the collective bargaining agreement for Private Bus Transportation will be adhered to. This means that your basic CLA salary is between € 3,014.72 and € 3,630.42 per month (based on a full-time contract, before taxes and mandatory insurance). Your salary will be determined based on age and experience;
•    100% of hours (including breaks) are paid;
•    A commuting allowance is provided for distances between 10 and 45 kilometers, at €0.23 per kilometer. 
•    You are also eligible for the irregularity, night and weekend bonuses;
•    We will meet with you yearly to understand how satisfied you are in your job and which skills you would like to develop.
•    We cover the costs for refreshing Code 95.

What do you bring?
•    You hold a European nationality.
•    You have a You have a driver's license D and code 95. 
•    You should be able to submit a Certificate of Conduct 
•    You have a good proficiency of the English language. Speaking a little bit Dutch is a bonus. 
•    You are flexible and enjoy working on different hours. 
- Minimum of 1 year experience as a Busdriver 

Would you like to know more or meet us? The door is open to you and we would like to get to know you.

Please send your cv with a photo to: susana.mourellefernandez@uwv.nl

Yes ! The Software Engineer candidate you've been working with has just called to let you know that they've accepted your offer. What a great way to start the day! 
After opening your laptop and grabbing a coffee, you're ready for the first meeting of the day: the daily stand-up. You have a busy day ahead filled with a great mix of HR and recruitment activities, and you update the team on everything that's on your agenda.
